content:
## How can I use {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %} with new Java versions?

Thanks to the upstream update from JDT, you can now build your project up to Java 22 with {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} as well. To use the experimental/preview language features, you need to modify your project settings.

Maven - modify `pom.xml`:

```xml
  <build>
    <pluginManagement>
      <plugins>
        <plugin>
          <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
          <configuration>
            <release>22</release>
            <compilerArgs>--enable-preview</compilerArgs>
          </configuration>
        </plugin>
      </plugins>
    </pluginManagement>
  </build>
```

Gradle:

```groovy
sourceCompatibility = 22
tasks.withType(JavaCompile) {
    options.compilerArgs += '--enable-preview'
}
tasks.withType(Test) {
    jvmArgs += "--enable-preview"
}
```

> Note: If you are modifying a project that was already opened in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}, you may need to force clean the workspace and reload. To do so, run command **Java: Clean Java Language Server Workspace**.
